name: Git/SCM URL with embedded plaintext credentials
attack_scenario: the embedded PAT is captured from a shared or archived console log (or from `ps`/`.git/config` on the agent) and reused to push malicious commits or exfiltrate every repo the token can reach
negative_test_hint: configure a pipeline checkout with "https://user:hunter2@github.com/org/repo.git" and assert the credential scan rejects the embedded secret instead of cloning with it

exemplar.explanation: A userinfo (user:password@) segment in a clone/checkout URL hardcodes a token or password into the pipeline and leaks it into build logs, `git remote -v`, and process listings. Jenkins provides credentialsId bindings precisely so the secret never appears in the URL or the script.
